title: Percona: PXC + ProxySQL topology
description: Runs `nexus topology percona`: PXC nodes with their ProxySQL-derived roles (writer/backup_writer) + the 2 routers. Galera is replication, not sharding (no shard map).

observe.what: node table (hostname/role/status); no shard section (Galera multi-primary replication, not sharded)

whatProves: PerconaAdapter.TopologyAsync renders the PXC + ProxySQL graph with Shards=null.
